changes: The client-side extension model: a client part in a Web Worker that sends component trees, an optional Wasm service part in the Host, per-extension credentials, the extension bus and declarative settings. Replaces the alpha panel and overlay system, which is gone.
Optional `section` on each `[[settings]]` table (`appearance` or `notifications`) shows that setting in that core Settings section instead of the extension's own page.
The icon `sparkles`, and `menu_button` shows its `icon` (it was accepted but not drawn).
